episodes.title: City Primeval
episodes.summary: Fifteen years after Raylan Givens left the hollers of Kentucky, a chance encounter in the Florida swamps sends him to Detroit and places him on a collision course with a violent sociopath and a formidable defense attorney.

episodes.title: The Oklahoma Wildman
episodes.summary: Raylan hunts a killer. Carolyn takes on a former client. Willa makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Backstabbers
episodes.summary: Raylan and the Detroit Police round up some promising suspects, provoking Carolyn's ire. Mansell and Sandy move on the Albanian mark. Things with Willa reach a breaking point.

episodes.title: Kokomo
episodes.summary: Raylan tangles with the Albanian mob. Mansell forms a new alliance. Carolyn lets her guard down.

episodes.title: You Good?
episodes.summary: Carolyn's past becomes Raylan's present. Mansell puts a plan into action.

episodes.title: Adios
episodes.summary: A botched kerfuffle sends Raylan's pursuit of Mansell into chaos.

episodes.title: The Question
episodes.summary: Raylan and Carolyn cross the line, as Raylan attempts to make it out of Detroit alive.
